decisions.reason: The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular fire-door system, so the firm's in-house R&D and certification knowledge lets it interpret results and refine the product easily.

As the consolidated umbrella for fast delivery after the narrower express programs A and B were dropped, this multi-model line builds on the firm's production and logistics competencies and remains worth keeping.
Fire and smoke protection doors are a certified core competency backed by in-house engineering, so the firm has strong related knowledge to sustain and improve the product.
